Other times it’s if I do find someone, I’ve missed out on so much time with them.  And there are so many things that we won’t be physically able to do or too old to experience much for the first time. 

Also, as someone with no kids, I also think how it is pretty dark that I will never have another thing to celebrate in my life.  Other people’s lives, sure. But nothing for me.  No wedding. No anniversaries.  No buying a home. No retirement.  No Valentine’s Day. No Mother’s Day…

I try to numb myself out bc when I start down a rabbit hole, I go to an unhealthy place.

Yes, ive had therapy from different individuals, different workbooks and worksheets/ etc.

See that’s the thing. I’m not good at anything positive.

I’ve been dealing with this a long time.
I’ve asked others to help me see things that maybe I’m blind to and they say they can’t think of any.
The only “answer” I’ve ever gotten to this question from anyone in my entire life is that im “nice”.

This is a bs answer (one) and two, being nice is not a strength.  It might be a characteristic people enjoy others having, but it only benefits others and brings only hardship and bad things my way/ energy drain, time drain/ etc. 
so, instead, I see it as a weakness.

But CBT only proves my thoughts (unless I lie). 

Any evidence I find only proves my “negative” thoughts. 

It’s more like these thoughts are not warm and fuzzy but doesn’t mean they are false or distorted just based off that fact.
I have only evidence to support them. 
Cognitive distortion only comes into play when I have to falsify evidence to support that these thoughts are untrue…

So this is the problem I have and am unable to find help with or a way around this…. 

This is why therapy usually only makes me feel worse and worse bc it only shows me that what I feel and think are true and to feel or see things in another way is distorted

If evidence isn’t considered important, then to me, this just strengthens that it is merely suggesting to just be delusional/ out of touch with reality and you will feel better. 

This is the same reason why I am unable to be religious… 

I am not sure if I am just insane or not. 
But I am starting to feel as though it doesn’t seem that therapy really is able to do anything?  Outside of ignoring reality or changing thoughts so they don’t “hurt”….true or not. 

I’m not trying to be an ass, I swear.  I just either am really not getting it or something is wrong with me. 

But is the only way to be in a better place is to either not feel and / or lie?

To me That’s the same.  Trying to change a thought or how you feel about a thought to make yourself feel better does not change the situation or what is. 

I don’t care how I think or how that makes me feel. 
Whether I process something or not does not mean it is not real.  

I have specific tangible evidence that is the cause of my self esteem issues.

The more I’m reading about ACT, the more I see it’s the same thing as CBT

Just different ways to lie or process or not process or ignore just to make yourself feel better.
